headline.en: UNI at $9.60 trades 61% above the DAO's own $5.96 fair-value mark while still net inflationary at +1.95%/yr — priced for a real-yield pivot that isn't on the docket.
headline.zh: UNI 报 $9.60，较 DAO 自身认定的 $5.96 公允价值锚定高出 61%，但年化净通胀仍为 +1.95%，市场已提前定价一场尚未提上议程的 real-yield(真实收益) 转向。

keyChanges.en: Buyback math still loses: $26.20M annualized buyback burns only 2.73M UNI vs 20M UNI emission — net dilution 17.27M UNI/yr at spot.
keyChanges.zh: 回购数学仍不成立：年化 $26.20M buyback 仅销毁 2.73M UNI，对冲不了 20M UNI 的年度增发，现价下净稀释 17.27M UNI/年。

keyChanges.en: Two Protocol Fee Expansion Temp Checks live (Arc, Robinhood Chain) — first credible path to grow the revenue base that feeds the burn, but Temp Check is 3+ governance steps from execution.
keyChanges.zh: 两项 Protocol Fee Expansion Temp Check 正在推进(Arc、Robinhood Chain)——这是扩大回购收入基数的首个可信路径，但 Temp Check 距离最终执行还差 3 步以上治理流程。

keyChanges.en: Positioning stretched: Binance L/S account ratio 1.82 with funding still flat at +0.01% — retail crowded long without perp premium, classic setup for a squeeze-out flush.
keyChanges.zh: 仓位过度倾斜：Binance 多空账户比 1.82，而 funding rate 仅 +0.01%——散户单边做多但永续溢价未起，典型的多头挤出前奏。

contrarianObservation.en: If either fee expansion Temp Check advances to on-chain vote in the next 30 days, annualized revenue could re-rate 30-50% higher, flipping net emission negative without any real-yield RFC needed. That's the specific reason a smart long is patient here — the burn math is one governance vote from working.
contrarianObservation.zh: 若两项 Protocol Fee Expansion 中的任意一项在 30 天内推进到链上投票，年化协议收入可能上修 30-50%，无需 real-yield 提案即可让净发行转负。这是聪明多头愿意在此耐心持有的具体理由——销毁模型距离跑通只差一次治理投票。

watchNext.en: Whether Arc or Robinhood Chain Temp Check advances to [Consensus Check] within 2 weeks — silence = bearish, forward motion = re-rate trigger.
watchNext.zh: 关注 Arc 或 Robinhood Chain Temp Check 能否在 2 周内推进到 [Consensus Check] 阶段——无进展即偏空，向前推动则是重估催化。

watchNext.en: Any RFC formally reviving real-yield / staker distribution — this is the regime-change variable, currently absent from top 5 threads.
watchNext.zh: 任何正式重启 real-yield / 质押者分配的 RFC——这是三阶段框架下的制度切换变量，当前 Top 5 论坛帖中缺席。

watchNext.en: Unichain TVL trajectory from the embarrassing $31.37M base — Uniswap's own L2 must show product-market fit or the long-term revenue thesis narrows.
watchNext.zh: Unichain TVL 从目前尴尬的 $31.37M 基数的走势——Uniswap 自家 L2 必须证明 product-market fit，否则长期收入叙事将收窄。

fullReasoning.en: Spot is doing the wrong thing for the fundamentals. UNI is up 8% on the week and TVL is up 6%, yet the core supply equation hasn't moved: $154M annualized revenue produces $26M of buybacks, which at $9.60 retires only 2.73M UNI against 20M UNI emitted — still +1.95%/yr net inflationary. The market is paying a 61% premium over the DAO's own $5.96 UNIfication burn mark for a real-yield pivot that has zero active RFC in the top governance threads. What's actually live are two Protocol Fee Expansion Temp Checks (Arc, Robinhood Chain) — meaningful because they grow the revenue base that feeds the burn, but Temp Check is early-stage; expecting execution inside a month is aggressive. Derivatives confirm the discomfort: L/S 1.82 with funding pinned near zero means retail is crowded long without paying for it — the setup that resolves via long liquidation, not squeeze. Unichain at $31M TVL is a quiet disaster for the long-term revenue thesis. Base case over 1-4 weeks: mean-reversion toward the $7-8 institutional zone, with $5.96 as the floor governance itself validated. Bearish is the honest read; upgrade to neutral if a fee expansion Temp Check clears to Consensus Check.
fullReasoning.zh: 现货走势与基本面背离。UNI 周涨 8%、TVL 涨 6%，但核心供给方程未动：$154M 年化协议收入产生 $26M buyback，在 $9.60 现价下仅回收 2.73M UNI，对应 20M UNI 的年度增发——净通胀仍达 +1.95%/年。市场正为一场根本不在 Top 治理帖中的 real-yield 转向支付溢价，价格较 DAO 自身在 UNIfication 中认定的 $5.96 销毁锚定高出 61%。真正在推进的是两项 Protocol Fee Expansion Temp Check(Arc、Robinhood Chain)——意义在于扩大回购的收入基数，但 Temp Check 属于治理早期阶段，一个月内落地过于乐观。衍生品数据印证了不适：多空比 1.82 而 funding rate 贴近零，意味着散户单边做多却未支付溢价——这种结构通常通过多头爆仓释放，而非轧空。Unichain 仅 $31M TVL，对长期收入叙事而言是一场无声的失败。1-4 周基准情景：向 $7-8 机构累积区间均值回归，$5.96 作为治理本身背书的下沿。诚实的读法就是偏空；一旦 Protocol Fee Expansion Temp Check 推进到 Consensus Check，则上调至中性。
